levers.detail: EBITDA margin 8.4% vs the peer median 2.09% — about 6.3pp of extra cushion baked into their pricing. There's room to push on price.

levers.title: Margins are widening
levers.detail: EBITDA margin climbed 6.7% → 8.4% — profit is expanding, so they can absorb a better price for us.

levers.title: Working capital is deteriorating
levers.detail: Cash-conversion cycle stretched 9 → 64 days — inventory and receivables increasingly tie up cash. They're cash-hungry: trade faster payment for a price cut.

levers.title: Collects its cash quickly
levers.detail: Gets paid in 46 days (peers 54.08) — a healthy cash position, so we can push to extend our own terms.

levers.title: Almost no debt
levers.detail: Debt-to-equity just 0.13 — a clean balance sheet, no interest burden to hide behind. There's room on price.

levers.title: Growing fast — wants to keep us
levers.detail: Revenue up ₹440 Cr → ₹581 Cr, with operating leverage 2.18× (profit growing faster than sales) — a growing supplier that will fight to keep our volume.

levers.title: Their suppliers are squeezing them (paying faster)
levers.detail: Days-payable fell 55 → 37 — their upstream cut their credit. A vendor forced to pay faster passes the same pressure to us; lock our terms in now.

levers.title: Fundamentally strengthening (F-score high)
levers.detail: Piotroski F-score 8/9 — improving on most fundamental checks (profitability, cash, efficiency). A healthy, strengthening supplier that wants to grow with us — good for a volume-commitment deal, though they can hold their price.

levers.title: Pays its own small vendors late
levers.detail: Delayed MSME dues (worst April 2024 to September 2024: ₹72.8 L) — a tight cash desk. They'll hold firm on terms, but that same cash need makes an early-pay discount attractive to them.

levers.title: Late on statutory filings
levers.detail: GST filing + EPF payment delays on record — often an early sign of a cash squeeze.
